question: How can even a wise person be affected while approaching the tip of nectar?
premises: The tip of nectar is mentioned
The essence of juice is involved
Even a wise person may be burning
inference: Therefore even the wise may experience burning in contact with the foremost nectar-essence.
uncertainties: The syntax and technical referents of amṛta+agraṃ and rasa+agreṇa are obscure.
plain_english: Even the wise one, burning with the foremost essence, at the tip of nectar...
